capabilities: Apply pending shared operations from the vault's operation cache without a server
Maintain a per-device CRDT cache for each collaborating node
Register participant nodes and evict expired ones by TTL
Create shared CRDT snapshots and rebuild local caches
Run manual or polled background sync from the command palette
disambiguation: Not a file-sync service; it assumes the vault files are already synchronized by shared storage and adds conflict-free collaborative editing on top.
extras: All collaborators must have the plugin installed and preferably on the same version; the underlying storage must already sync the files; the user ID is fixed to a per-device node ID and is not configurable; the manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README also covers developer lint/release workflow.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for multiple people to edit the same vault concurrently without merge conflicts or a dedicated collaboration server.

requires.name: Shared Vault on every collaborator's device
any shared storage that synchronizes the vault files

summary: Serverless conflict-free collaboration layer that syncs vault edits between devices via Yjs operation files stored inside the vault.
